title: fix: include viewName in navigation href and preserve listViews through defineStack
body:
`NavigationItem` of type `'object'` with a `viewName` (e.g. `calendar`, `pipeline`) generated hrefs that dropped the view segment, always falling back to the default grid view. Additionally, `defineStack()` from `@objectstack/spec` stripped `listViews` from object definitions via Zod validation, so even with the correct URL the console's `ObjectView` never saw the calendar/kanban view definitions and always fell back to grid. ```ts // CRM nav config already specifies viewName { id: 'nav_events', type: 'object', objectName: 'event', viewName: 'calendar', ... } // Before: /apps/crm_app/event → grid (wrong, and listViews missing from objectDef) // After: /apps/crm_app/event/view/calendar → calendar (correct, listViews preserved) ``` ### Changes #### Part 1: href generation — append `/view/${viewName}` when present - **`packages/types/src/app.ts`** — Add optional `viewName` to `NavigationItem` - **`packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts`** — Add `viewName` to Zod schema - **`packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`** — `resolveHref` appends `/view/${viewName}` when present - **`packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx`** — Same fix in `MobileBottomNav` inline href logic - **`apps/console/src/App.tsx`** — `findFirstRoute()` includes `viewName` for home redirect - **`apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx`** — Console mobile bottom nav includes `viewName` - **`apps/console/src/components/SearchResultsPage.tsx`** — Search results include `viewName` - **`packages/layout/src/__tests__/NavigationRenderer.test.tsx`** — Test for viewName href generation #### Part 2: view data pipeline — preserve `listViews` through `defineStack()` - **`apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts`** — Re-merge `listViews` into objects **after** `defineStack()` validation strips them (MSW/browser mode) - **`objectstack.config.ts`** — Same fix plus add missing `views` array to the merged config (server mode) `defineStack()` validates config through Zod schemas which strip non-standard properties like `listViews` from objects. The existing `mergeViewsIntoObjects()` call was being undone by the subsequent `defineStack()`. The fix applies `defineStack()` first for validation, then re-merges views from the raw configs into the validated objects. Without this, `ObjectView` received `objectDef.listViews = undefined` and always fell back to a default grid view regardless of the URL.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 导航到 Calendar 视图时未激活正确视图类型（viewName 被忽略） > ### 问题复现 > - 在 CRM 应用（或类似场景）侧边栏点击 "Calendar" 菜单。 > - 实际展示的是表格列表视图（grid），而不是 calendar。 > > #### 代码根因 > - CRM app 的 navigation 配置项如下： > ```ts > { > id: 'nav_events', > type: 'object', > objectName: 'event', > viewName: 'calendar', // 已正确配置，期望打开 calendar 视图 > label: { key: 'crm.navigation.calendar', defaultValue: 'Calendar' }, > icon: 'calendar' > } > ``` > - Event 对象的 listViews 也已正确定义 calendar 类型： > ```ts > listViews: { > calendar: { type: 'calendar', ...calendarConfig }, ... } > } > ``` > - 但 platform 的 NavigationRenderer/resolveHref 函数忽略了 viewName，只生成为 `/apps/crm_app/event`，未带上 `/view/calendar` > ```tsx > case 'object': > return { href: `${basePath}/${item.objectName ?? ''}`, external: false }; > ``` > - 导致 ObjectView fallback 到 grid 视图。 > > #### 影响 > - 不能通过导航直接打开 calendar/kanban 等特定视图，只会显示默认 grid 视图。 > - "Calendar"、"Pipeline"等菜单都会丢失视图参数，严重影响多视图体验。 > > ### 修复建议 > 1. `NavigationItem` 类型添加 viewName 属性。 > 2. NavigationRenderer.resolveHref 中，如果 item.viewName 存在，URL 应拼接 `/view/${item.viewName}`，如 `/apps/crm_app/event/view/calendar`。 > > ### 参考案例 > - examples/crm/src/apps/crm.app.ts > - examples/crm/src/views/event.view.ts > - packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx > > ### 截图 > > > --- > 本问题属于平台 bug，请尽快修复。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
